operationName: Ebola PHEIC Response — 2026 Bundibugyo Outbreak, DRC & Uganda
heroHeadline: Ebola Toll Reaches 8,116 Confirmed Cases, 3,924 Deaths in DRC
heroSubtitle: DRC's National Institute of Public Health reported 49 new cases, 23 deaths and 18 recoveries in 24 hours as of 30 September. Cases rose by more than 2,000 in September, and Africa CDC warns of risk to neighbouring countries.
footerNote: Data sourced from DRC Ministry of Health (MSANTE) situation reports, ECDC outbreak tracker, WHO Disease Outbreak News, Africa CDC statements, Uganda Ministry of Health, CDC Ebola Situation Summary, MSF, AP, AFP, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, Healio, and UN News. Case counts are rapidly evolving.
